subject: Re: Kickoff: EMCAPSNet - M2 status: robustness real, cost curve ugly
body:
M2 status.

M1 recap: repro clean. Eval on the released checkpoint gives 1.8 test error on smallNORB with patching off and 1.3 with --patching=True, exactly matching the README (paper says 1.4, we and the README get 1.3 - noted in the log).

M2 results: on held-out azimuth splits, EMCAPSNet degrades 3.1 points vs. 8.7 for our CNN baseline at matched params - the viewpoint-robustness claim is real, at least on smallNORB-class data. Novel-elevation is similar (2.8 vs. 7.9).

The concern going into M3: EM routing cost. Per-step time grows much faster than input resolution - our 96x96 prototype is ~9x slower per step than 32x32, and memory scales worse. Gustavo's projection says anything ImageNet-sized is off the table without serious kernel work. So the June stress-test is genuinely decisive: if the cost curve doesn't bend with the optimizations Gustavo is testing, my memo will be "no for the general stack, maybe for small pose-critical verticals".

Sweep rehearsal on titan is scheduled for Jun 12.

Yara
